mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are looking at 58 degrees under overcast skies near Fireman's Park. The moon is in a waning gibbous phase, and the ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. Expect an overnight low of 48 degrees with no rain predicted.

In city news, Verona continues its long-term partnership with AECOM for engineering services, with regular reports provided to the City Council. Additionally, the Wisconsin Department of Transportation is seeking community feedback on the US 18/151 corridor study, with meetings scheduled for November 18 and 19.

There is plenty to do in town over the next few days. Today, join us for trivia at Hop Haus or Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, check out Paddy Mac's for live music, head to Insight Wellness for yoga, or stop by The Bogey Factory for trivia. Later this week, look forward to the Main Street Trick or Treat and ART House 360 events on Thursday.

In our weekly report, officers handled several calls for service. One notable incident occurred on October 25, when police located a 40-year-old man who had been stopped at an intersection for twenty minutes, leading to an arrest for an O W I.
Treat yourself to today's delicious flavor of the day, Chocolate Caramel Twist. Our doors are open until 10 PM tonight, so stop by to enjoy a scoop before we head home for the night.
